sections.heading: Your tutorial gear
sections.body: Crafting granted a Tutorial Chest. It is intentionally weaker than normal crafted gear, but strong enough to begin Lumo Ruins.

sections.heading: What to do
sections.body: Open the Equipment tab in Inventory and equip the Tutorial Chest to complete First Steps.

sections.heading: Finishing
sections.body: Once the Tutorial Chest is equipped, First Steps completes and normal Shenic combat areas become available.
